app.name: Perceptron
app.tagline: Train neural networks locally, guided by AI

engine.title: Engine status
engine.error: Could not connect to the Engine

settings.description: LLM providers, per-purpose profiles and keys (stored in the OS keychain).

llm.activeHint: Which model serves each purpose (architect, agent, report…).
llm.testFail: The LLM could not be used: {{error}}
llm.keyPlaceholder: Paste the key (it is never shown again)

desktop.title: Local engine (PyTorch)
desktop.changeHint: Only PyTorch is reinstalled; the app is not.
desktop.applying: Reinstalling PyTorch and restarting the engine… it can take several minutes.

updates.title: Updates
updates.installing: Downloading and installing… the app restarts when done.
updates.safe: Your projects and data are not changed: only the app is updated.

copilot.title: Copilot
copilot.openProject: Open a project to chat with the copilot.
copilot.intro: Tell me what you want to achieve or ask about any step: I explain and propose changes that you accept or dismiss.
copilot.unavailable: No LLM is configured (or the project's privacy is L0). The wizard keeps working with rules.

home.empty: No projects yet. Create one to get started.

project.name: Name
project.goalHint: Describe what you want to achieve; the AI uses it to make proposals.
project.noTemplateHint: Pick a use case to preconfigure modality, task and metric.

actions.title: Project
actions.hint: Duplicate copies the configuration (goal, task, metric, privacy), without data or runs. Archive keeps everything and hides it from the list.
actions.deleteWarning: Data, versions, runs, models and the project folder are deleted permanently. This cannot be undone; to just hide it, archive it.

privacy.L1: L1 — Aggregated metadata only (never individual values).
privacy.L2: L2 — Metadata + a few samples with personal data masked.
privacy.L3: L3 — Raw samples (non-sensitive data or a local LLM).

data.addHint: Upload a file (CSV, Excel, Parquet, JSONL, ZIP) or a folder with one subfolder per class (images, audio, text).
data.targetHint: What the model must predict. If you don't pick it, it is inferred.
data.empty: No data in this project yet.
data.dvcHint: Download this version with its .dvc file (DVC 3)

train.noData: Load data in the Data tab first.

experiments.empty: No model has been trained yet.
experiments.compareHint: Highlighted rows are hyperparameters that differ between runs.
experiments.compareSelect: Select two or more runs to compare them.
experiments.sameConfig: The runs share architecture and pipeline: only hyperparameters change.

run.title: Run
run.evaluation: Evaluation on the sealed test set
run.sealedHint: The sealed test set was not used to pick the model; evaluating it gives an honest estimate of its performance.
run.mlflowHint: See the run in the MLflow UI (optional)

models.title: Registered models
models.challengeWon: The challenger won ({{metric}}: {{challenger}} vs {{champion}} on {{n}} cases) and is the new champion.
models.challengeLost: The challenger did not improve ({{metric}}: {{challenger}} vs {{champion}} on {{n}} cases): the champion stays.

audit.title: LLM call audit
audit.empty: This project made no LLM calls.

help.goal: Describe what you want to achieve. The copilot helps you refine it.
help.data: Upload data or pick an existing version.
help.quality: Review the profile and quality alerts before training.
help.labeling: The model learns from labeled examples.
help.task: What kind of problem it is and which metric measures success.
help.architecture: Neural network proposals for your data (from the AI or by rules).
help.hpo: How the best hyperparameters are searched within your budget.
help.budget: Time, device and whether the agent should iterate on its own.

goal.label: What do you want to achieve?
goal.hint: E.g.: detect whether a bearing is about to fail from its sound.
goal.placeholder: Describe it as you would to a colleague…

labeling.ok: Your data already has labels in “{{target}}”.
labeling.none: No target column was detected: pick it in Data or label your data in the Labeling tab.

task.metricHint: If you don't pick one, validation loss is used.

budget.maxTimeHint: Whichever comes first stops the search: time or trials.
budget.autonomousHint: The agent decides architecture, search and iterations within the limits.

review.summary: Up to {{max_trials}} trials of up to {{max_epochs_per_trial}} epochs will be trained; the best on validation is then evaluated on the sealed test set.
review.summaryAgent: The agent will iterate with up to {{max_trials}} trials in total and close with the best model, evaluated on the sealed test set.
review.missing: Missing steps: data, preparation and architecture (or agent mode).

why.question: Why is the recommendation in the “{{step}}” step a good fit for my project? Explain it with my data and tell me what you would change.

agent.launchHint: The LLM acts as an ML engineer: proposes, trains, diagnoses and iterates. The system enforces the limits and the sealed test set is only opened at the end.
agent.approvalNeeded: The agent asks for your approval
agent.result: Result on the sealed test set

arch.title: Architectures
arch.empty: No architectures yet. Propose one from Train or the wizard.
arch.name: Name
arch.codeNeedsValid: Fix the errors to see the PyTorch code.
arch.selectHint: Click a block in the graph to edit its parameters. Connect blocks by dragging from a handle; Delete removes the selected one.

pipeline.title: Data pipelines
pipeline.empty: No pipelines yet. They are proposed when preparing the data.
pipeline.paramsInvalid: The parameters JSON is invalid; it was not applied.
pipeline.selectHint: Click a step to edit, reorder or remove it.
pipeline.previewAfter: First train rows after step “{{step}}” (includes unsaved changes).
pipeline.previewAfterAll: First train rows after the whole pipeline (includes unsaved changes).

define.explain: I'm defining the architecture, step “{{step}}”. The options are: {{options}}. Which one fits my data and why?

desktop.preparingHint: The first time, the Python environment and the PyTorch build for your hardware are installed. It can take several minutes and needs a connection.

expert.title: Expert mode: the model as code
expert.warning: Code is not declarative: Perceptron cannot explain or validate it like an ArchSpec. It runs in a sandbox with no network, no processes and no file access outside the run, with memory and time limits. Review the code before saving it, especially if the LLM proposed it.
expert.saveTitle: Test in the sandbox and save
expert.acknowledge: I understand the code is not declarative and runs in a sandbox
expert.checking: Building the model in the sandbox…
expert.checked: Model built in the sandbox: {{params}} parameters.
expert.sandboxNote: It is trained and evaluated inside the sandbox. To change it, edit a copy: the original stays as provenance.

export.title: Export the model
export.hint: Each format is verified against PyTorch on real validation data (ONNX: max difference 1e-4; fp16: 1e-2).

playground.title: Try the model
playground.textHint: Normalized and tokenized exactly as in training.
playground.audioHint: WAV, FLAC, OGG or MP3; resampled as in training.
playground.tokens: Contribution of each word to the prediction
playground.spectrogram: Spectrogram: the moments and frequencies that weighed most

explain.hint: Which variables weigh the most (Shapley values on validation).

fairness.hint: Mark sensitive attributes (e.g. region, age) to compare the model across groups.

robustness.hint: How much the model degrades with noise, missing values and other perturbations.

report.hint: The report includes what you already computed (explanation, fairness, robustness).

labeling.title: Assisted labeling
labeling.newClassesHint: Comma separated (added to those already in the dataset).
labeling.queueDone: You reviewed this batch. Reload the queue to continue.
labeling.polygonHint: Click to add vertices; click the first one to close.
labeling.segmentHint: Play and mark the start and end of the event.
labeling.zeroShotHint: Suggests labels with a pretrained model from the class names, no training needed (first 200 pending).

sources.name: Name
sources.passwordHint: Stored in the system keychain, never in the project.
sources.queryHint: Read-only. Read in batches and saved as a project copy.

auth.subtitle: Team Server · sign in to continue
auth.locked: The account is locked for a few minutes after failed attempts.
auth.ssoFailed: Single sign-on failed. Try again or ask your Admin.

admin.title: Administration
admin.description: Team Server users, roles and audit log.
admin.forbidden: You need to be a server or workspace Admin.
admin.name: Name
admin.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. The user can change it later.
admin.rolesHint: A project role overrides the workspace role: someone can be Editor in one project and Viewer everywhere else.
admin.noMembers: This workspace has no members yet.

queue.title: Training queue
queue.serverOnly: The queue only exists on the Team Server.
queue.modeQueue: Studies run on the server workers. Running-study quota: {{user}} per person and {{workspace}} per workspace.
queue.modeLocal: No queue configured: studies run inside the server process. Quota: {{user}} per person and {{workspace}} per workspace.
queue.noWorkers: No workers connected: studies wait in the queue.
queue.inProcess: Studies run on the server itself.

remote.title: Team servers
remote.hint: Connect this desktop to a Team Server to train on its (GPU) workers and share projects with your team.
remote.name: Name
remote.passwordHint: Only used to sign in: a token is kept in the keychain, never the password.

policies.title: Policies
policies.maxPrivacyHint: No project in the workspace sends more than this level (L0 = nothing).
policies.localMaxHint: Can be higher when the model runs on your own network (RF-PRV-02).
policies.providersHint: Comma separated (e.g. ollama, anthropic). Empty = all.
policies.ssoHint: Configured on the server (PERCEPTRON_SERVER__OIDC); see docs/ops/sso.md.
policies.budgetHint: Empty = no quota. When reached, AI features fall back to rules.

monitoring.noReports: No checks yet: they run every N predictions or on demand.
monitoring.emailHint: Comma-separated recipients (requires SMTP on the server).
monitoring.noDeployments: No models in use. Deploy the champion from Models.

retrain.title: Automatic retraining
retrain.hint: With new labeled data (streaming sources or feedback) a challenger with the same architecture is trained; it is compared with the champion on data neither has seen and promoted only if it improves.
retrain.cronHint: minute hour day month weekday, e.g. 0 3 * * 1

license.title: License
license.noEnforce: In this version the license is reported but does not restrict usage.
license.pasteHint: Paste the content of the license.json sent by Preteco.

telemetry.title: Usage telemetry
telemetry.hint: Optional and anonymous: version, operating system, aggregated hardware and how often each feature is used. Never your data, column names, paths or model metrics.
telemetry.noEndpoint: No destination configured: nothing is sent even if enabled.
telemetry.preview: See exactly what would be sent

churn.title: Customer churn
churn.goal: Which customers will cancel next month?

ticket-resolution-time.title: Ticket resolution time
ticket-resolution-time.goal: Estimate how many hours each support ticket will take to resolve.

ticket-category.title: Ticket category
ticket-category.goal: Classify each support ticket into its category from its text.

visual-inspection.title: Visual defect inspection
visual-inspection.goal: Detect defective parts from photos of the production line.

damage-segmentation.title: Damage segmentation
damage-segmentation.goal: Mark the damaged areas in each photo.

document-ocr.title: Delivery note text
document-ocr.goal: Extract the text from scanned delivery notes.

demand-forecast.title: Weekly demand per SKU
demand-forecast.goal: Forecast the demand for each product over the coming weeks.

sensor-anomalies.title: Sensor anomalies
sensor-anomalies.goal: Detect anomalous behavior in equipment telemetry.

machine-sound.title: Engine faults by sound
machine-sound.goal: Detect engine faults from audio recordings.

hpo.title: Study analysis
hpo.empty: The study has no trials yet.
hpo.noImportance: Estimated with at least 4 finished trials.

modelsCache.title: Pretrained models
modelsCache.empty: No pretrained model has been downloaded yet.
modelsCache.prefetchHint: Only models from the curated catalog, with reviewed commercial licenses.
modelsCache.downloading: Downloading in the background; it shows up in the list when done.

cost.title: Estimated cost
cost.size: Effective size: {{train}} training examples out of {{total}} ({{disk}} MB on disk).
cost.tensors: As input tensors, train takes {{mb}} MB.
cost.model: {{params}} parameters · estimated memory per batch of {{batch}}: {{memory}} MB.

op.duplicateProject: created it by duplicating another project
op.rollbackModel: rolled back to the previous model

promote.description: The project configuration is uploaded with the data and runs you pick; the rest stays on this computer.
promote.hint: The data of the selected runs is uploaded even if you don't check it.

status.succeeded: Done: it is now a team project.

pipelineAdvice.title: Suggested improvements

pipelineAdvice.none: The pipeline already fits this data.

system.title: System
system.quotasHint: Configured on the server (PERCEPTRON_MAX_RUNNING_STUDIES_PER_*). The LLM quota is under Policies.

retention.title: Version retention
retention.hint: Versions in use (runs, labeling, agent) and their parents are always kept.
retention.inUse_one: {{count}} more is kept because it is in use.
retention.inUse_other: {{count}} more are kept because they are in use.
